title: IdentityFuseResult
description: Multi-modal fusion result resolving speaker identities and voice merges across video, audio, and transcript signals.

identities.description: Resolved identities for each active speaker voice hypothesis.

voice_id.description: The diarization voice hypothesis id (e.g. spk_0, spk_3, spk_5).

name.description: The resolved human name of this speaker.

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of how the visual, audio, or dialogue signals were fused.

merges.description: Pairs of voice hypotheses that represent the same individual and should be merged.

keep_voice_id.description: The primary voice ID that should be kept (typically the one with more speech time).

merge_voice_id.description: The duplicate voice ID that should be merged into keep_voice_id.

reason.description: Why these two voices represent the same person.
